title: Profile page password card draws the server's English refusal for set-password and change-password
body:
repo:objectstack#6 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjQkY5yXZrN9BEA3rEK

Filing gate: ① a product defect, left out of PR #37965 (`Fixes #34171`) as review nit N2 of contract review 7219466980.

## Facts (main after #37965)

- The profile page's password card calls `setInitialPassword` and `changePassword` and draws `err.message` raw, so a cloud-managed runtime's 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` refusal still shows the server's English sentence there, while the login / forgot / reset / set-password pages now show the localized one (`passwordDoorRefusalMessages` in app-shell `signInRefusalMessages.ts`).
- Four client methods in `ui/packages/auth/src/createAuthClient.ts` still throw without `toAuthError` (`sendVerificationEmail`, `signOut`, `updateUser`, social sign-in), so an ADR-0112 envelope's code is dropped on those paths.

## Expected

The profile password card maps `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` through the same password-door map; the four methods throw through `toAuthError` (`updateUser` only after #37433 settles that hunk).

Dedupe words: profile password card RESOURCE_CONFLICT English, toAuthError remaining callers, changePassword refusal localized
